purpose: Record the actual received independent fidelity and public-source-safety decisions for the 32 substantive derived scientific accounts and the shared documentation component. This record is a source-bound summary, not a substitute for the research accounts.
publication_authority: The owner authorized all 32 scientifically faithful, public-safe derived accounts on 2026-11-13, subject to source-specific independent review; bounded normal main integration and ordinary existing Pages deployment were also authorized.

scientific_status.basis: Existing accepted scientific qualifications preserved; this documentary publication does not repeat or requalify the science.
scientific_status.original_evidence_limits: The historical SPR-L1 original-proof exception and every unit-specific source/review limitation remain explicit in the identity map and research.

public_documentary_status.reviewed_material: Substantive scientific accounts, structured properties and predicates, guarded relationship and interaction bodies, examples, alternatives, negatives, unresolved and novelty dispositions, maintained Pages and source notes at the declared per-group scope.

scope_separation.whole_composition_and_delivery: Exact integrated Git-tree review, original repository regression, normal branch/main publication, Actions and served Pages are separately evidenced delivery stages. Component acceptance alone does not attest those stages.
scope_separation.visual_validation: Actual desktop/mobile inspection is a separate result; source or link checks do not establish visual acceptance.
scope_separation.native_implementation: No native runtime, installation, release, new issue or final RLGWO acceptance is granted by scientific publication.

public_source_safety.content_basis: Original derived scientific explanations and normalized scientific data, checked against the accepted frozen sources and their final review dispositions.
public_source_safety.transformations: Private access locators, credentials, source-worker attribution identifiers, unrelated operational records and restricted raw inputs are excluded or represented by public-safe descriptions. Source notes distinguish transformations and scientific limitations. Legitimate public bibliography identifiers are retained.
public_source_safety.rights_scope: References identify third-party research; this publication does not claim redistribution rights to the cited works or publish the private research archives verbatim.
public_source_safety.substantive_withholding: No generic private-custody restriction is applied to the accepted derived findings. The final public reviewers identified no remaining material publication-safety finding within their declared scope. Unavailable historical evidence is disclosed as unavailable, rather than reconstructed.
public_source_safety.review_limits: Source-specific fidelity and publication safety at the documented examination scope; no assertion of exhaustive legal adjudication or cognitive rereading of every structured row.
